# fshy: Email in full

> Sending, receiving, forwarding and inbox APIs.

Data as of 2026-11-20, the date of the published data. Version `7e4259089a05`: the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of every record's Markdown, topic by topic in the one order (hosted before self-hosted, then verdict, provider name, record id); it changes whenever a record does.

This topic is 339 KB, about 92K tokens in full, more than the 300 KB, about 81K tokens one file holds, so it is split: its hosted records by verdict group, then its self-hosted records in one last group, and a group over that size into balanced parts. The parts in the order below are the one order (hosted before self-hosted, then verdict, provider name, record id). How to read a record: https://fshy.ajam.dev/llms-full.txt.

## Parts

- [Usable](https://fshy.ajam.dev/t/email/llms-full-usable.txt): 30 records; 161 KB, about 44K tokens
- [Trial](https://fshy.ajam.dev/t/email/llms-full-trial.txt): 3 records; 26 KB, about 7K tokens
- [Paid only](https://fshy.ajam.dev/t/email/llms-full-paid.txt): 9 records; 114 KB, about 31K tokens
- [Rejected](https://fshy.ajam.dev/t/email/llms-full-rejected.txt): 3 records; 29 KB, about 8K tokens
- [Dead](https://fshy.ajam.dev/t/email/llms-full-dead.txt): 1 records; 6 KB, about 2K tokens
- [Self-hosted, the last resort](https://fshy.ajam.dev/t/email/llms-full-self-hosted.txt): 1 records; 4 KB, about 1K tokens
